credentials.subtitle: Native plugin configuration — managed in the plugin config, displayed here as read-only status.

strategy.title: Matching strategy
strategy.subtitle: Set algebra over identifier dimensions — which Shopware field matches which Topdata identifier. The DSL string is the single source of truth.

dsl.label: DSL
dsl.helpText: Set algebra: '&' within a group (AND), '|' between groups (OR). Example: product.ean:ean | product.manufacturer_number:mpn

dslHelp.title: DSL syntax reference
dslHelp.intro: The matching strategy is a set algebra over identifier dimensions: it defines which Shopware field is matched against which Topdata identifier. The DSL string is the single source of truth — the visual builder above is a live-synced view over it.

grammar.title: Grammar
grammar.leaf: Each condition (leaf) pairs a Shopware field with a Topdata identifier:
grammar.and: AND — all leaves in a group must match
grammar.or: OR — at least one group must match

shopFields.title: Shopware fields
shopFields.property: a property value of the given property group
shopFields.customField: a custom field value of the given name

pairings.title: Allowed pairings
pairings.intro: Not every field can be paired with every identifier — the allowed combinations are:
pairings.providerScope: articleNumbers.<providerId> restricts a leaf to a single provider (e.g. articleNumbers.4123).

examples.title: Examples
examples.one: Match products by EAN first, fall back to the manufacturer number.
examples.two: Both conditions must match: EAN and manufacturer.
examples.three: Match the product number only against article numbers of provider 4123.

validation.title: Invalid strategy
validation.unreachable: Could not reach the validation endpoint.

dirtyConfirm.title: Unsaved changes
dirtyConfirm.message: Your current strategy differs from the last loaded value. Applying the preset will discard your edits — are you sure?

save.successMessage: The matching strategy was validated and saved.
save.failedGeneric: Could not save the strategy — please check the connection.

copy.title: DSL copied
copy.message: The DSL string was copied to the clipboard.
